name: Pesto Ground Beef and Zucchini Skillet
why: One-skillet ground beef with zucchini, sun-dried tomatoes and basil pesto - a Mediterranean-leaning low-carb dish (meat + non-starchy veg + fat, no rice/pasta base). Source publishes 414 cal / 5.8g carbs / 23.8g protein per serving, inside the band (near floor, high 33.9g fat so realistic). Beef, zucchini, sun-dried tomatoes and pesto all map to the board; only goat cheese is unmapped (feta/cream-cheese are plausible board swaps). Distinct from the existing rice-based cheesy-zucchini-beef-rice-skillet (no rice, pesto/goat-cheese profile). Scales to 14 by weigh-and-divide.
